VISUAL PROCESSING

No view into experience

Input→Circuit→Response

A screen of psychedelic patterns would not show what this fly sees. Motion presets directly stimulate identified motion-circuit cells; they do not simulate light passing through an eye.

FlyWire wiring and neuron annotations, with electrical parameters based on Shiu and colleagues.
